result.title: VideoGen Model 1: Prompt Expansion Versus Formatting in Audiovisual Generation
result.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Model page: https://videogen.io/model-1 ; VideoGen: https://videogen.io
result.summary: Creative prompt expansion improved overall audiovisual quality scores over raw prompts in a controlled pilot of VideoGen Model 1, our post-trained version of MiniMax H3. We compared the raw, reformatted, and expanded versions of 30 prompts, holding the generator, seed, and sampling settings fixed. Each clip was rated separately on five dimensions. Their mean formed an overall score on a 1-10 scale. Compared with formatting alone, overall scores increased by 0.63 points (95% interval: [+0.11, +1.15]) under VA-Judger and 0.15 points (95% interval: [-0.03, +0.35]) under Gemini 3.8 Flash, whose overall change remained uncertain. Prompt-alignment scores increased by 0.97 points under VA-Judger and 0.50 under Gemini. VA-Judger also showed higher audio quality; visual-quality ratings changed little under either judge.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在固定生成器、种子与采样设置的对照试验中，比较 30 个提示的原始、重排版与创意扩写版本，用两类评判模型对音视频片段按五个维度评分，发现提示扩写主要提升总体与对齐分数，音质有改善而视觉质量变化不大。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究内容为音视频生成中的提示工程与评分差异，不涉及内部推理状态、视觉证据利用或停止决策，缺乏可供 LVR 借鉴的具体线索。
